description: Read-only access to App Store Connect and Google Play: apps, releases, and reviews.
name: io.github.JohnBilousov/appstore-play-mcp

environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API key id. Omit the App Store block to run Play-only.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Path to the AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8 private key downloaded from App Store Connect.
environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google service account JSON with Android Publisher access.
environmentVariables.name: PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Play package names. Required for Play: the API cannot list apps.
environmentVariables.name: PLAY_PACKAGES

title: App Store & Google Play
